Welcome to us! 

With us, you and your family can live centrally to everything, with proximity to most things in the heart of Svolvær. 

From the top floor you can even scout Svolværgeita, and a short walk takes you to the hiking terrain where you can climb Svolværgeita and the surrounding mountains (Djevelporten, Fløya, Blåtinden). 

The house is on three floors, with spacious hallway, laundry room, 2 bathrooms, 5 bedrooms, kitchen, living room, and dining room. 

Free parking. 

Possibility to borrow baby bed, stroller, high chair, etc. just ask!

The space
The detached house consists of three floors where you enter the 1st floor, consisting of a hallway, one bedroom and a laundry room.

The 2nd floor contains a kitchen, living room, dining room, bedroom, and bathroom with toilet, sink and shower. 

The 3rd floor contains 3 bedrooms, storage rooms, and bathroom with toilet, sink and bathtub. One of the bedrooms is entered from the largest bedroom (family room with double bed and sofa bed). The bathroom on this floor is entered from the master bedroom. 

We have several offers for guests: 
- Laundry down in the laundry room as desired. 
- Loan of equipment for babies/children, we have, among other things, a bed for babies with bed linen, a stroller for children (not with a baby insert), a rocking chair, high chairs, children's toys and children's books, as well as kitchen utensils for children. You must request in advance, and we will make the equipment available to you. 
- Free shower soap, shampoo and conditioner. 
- Tips for hiking trails and generally recommended trips on demand.
- various books and games that can be used

The house is in the center of Svolvær, with walking distance to shop, shopping center, quay promenade, kiosk, and as previously mentioned to a handful of hiking trails.

Overall, great spot right on the edge of Svolvær downtown. Walking distance to the waterfront and restaurants and many other things. Check in was easy and Julie was super responsive with any questions. Great space with lots of beds. The only downside was a recently whitewashed floor that still smelled slightly of paint fumes. It’s a shame - the wood floor in the listing looks so nice. I would absolutely stay here again though.

We had a wonderful stay at this charming house in Svolvær. Its central location makes it a perfect stopover for one or two nights while exploring the Lofoten Islands. Although it's close to the main road, it was very convenient for getting around. Walking distance to the supermarkets, which was very convenient. Excellent WW2 museum nearby - highly recommend.
The house has a unique character and charm—you can really feel that it has its own history, while at the same time being beautifully renovated with modern comforts. It is incredibly spacious, bright, and offers plenty of room to relax. We truly enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend it to anyone visiting Lofoten.

Wonderful stay
We didn’t realise the home would have a shared laundry with another neighbour - we aren’t sure if this is the host or not. But it might be something worth noting for future guests, as this neighbour technically has access to your rooms/accommodation. 
The curtains aren’t as black out as all our other airbnbs in lofoten so it did make sleep a little more difficult. And the bed sheets smelt a little bit off / damp. 
Otherwise, great location, plenty of beds which would suit a large group travelling! Good amenities in kitchen. 
The space is pretty clean. Nice big couch and dining table, again good for larger groups. 
Upstairs shower is a bit messy, downstairs bathroom is lovely with heated tiles.
Communication and check in was very easy and flawless! 
It seems normal in Norway to also empty bins, strip bed sheets etc before you leave. Something which is often less common in other countries so worth noting !
